[[File:Goblin (Lumbridge) chathead.png|left|90px]]
'''Goblins''' are level 2 monsters found in [[Lumbridge]], in [[Lumbridge forest]], and slightly south-east of the [[Lumbridge#Lumbridge Market|Lumbridge Market]]. A lone goblin is found in the [[Wheat (scenery)|wheat]] field in [[Draynor Village]].

==Update history==
{{UH|
* {{UL|type=update|update=Patch Notes: Part 2 - Combat Style Modernisation|date=2 March 2026}}
** Default base hit chances increased:
*** Magic ('weak'): 65 → 70
*** Melee ('same'): 55 → 60
*** Ranged ('strong'): 45 → 50

* {{UL|type=update|update=Patch Notes: Early-Game Rebalance|date=16 February 2026}}
** A number of early-game mobs will once again drop actual armour, weapons, ores, and bars.
*** Tiny plated bronze salvage → Bronze gauntlets
*** Tiny spiky bronze salvage → Bronze spear, Bronze dagger/Bronze off hand dagger
*** Medium plated bronze salvage → Bronze kiteshield

* {{UL|type=patch|update=November PostJam Patch Week - This Week In RuneScape|date=26 November 2024}}
** Wood spirit and oak tree spirit have been added to the loot tables.
*** In most cases we targeted weak or "less-useful" salvage drops to replace them with, while in a handful of cases cases we replaced logs or other items such as stone spirits.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (19 December 2012)|date=19 December 2012}}
** Several goblins have been graphically updated to the same standard as the recently reworked goblins.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=What's Mine is Yours|date=17 October 2012}}
** The Goblin Village has also received a full graphical rework, as have all surface-dwelling goblin NPCs, the Chaos Temple near Doric's house and the Burthorpe wall north-west of Falador.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (13 May 2010)|date=13 May 2010}}
** Goblin death animations should now be a bit quicker.

* {{UL|type=update|update=Runescape beta is now online!|date=4 January 2001}}
** Added to game.
}}

==Trivia==
* Before the [[Battle of Lumbridge]], there were a lot more spawns between [[Draynor Village]] and [[Lumbridge]], south of [[Mill Lane Mill]], and north of [[Lumbridge Swamp]].
* Prior to the release of [[Til Death Do Us Part]], there was an attackable goblin found south of [[Draynor Manor]], which was replaced with [[Victor (goblin)|Victor]].
